pr_body:
**Description:**
Compile ES2015 object super to ES5
[plugin-transform-object-super](https://babeljs.io/docs/en/babel-plugin-transform-object-super) in babel

**Related issue (if exists):**
fix #2684
pr_comments:
babel will generate code like `var obj = (_obj = { xxx });`,
but looks like swc removes ParenExpr in some pass.

Yeah, I think we should create an error from linter, as it will move a runtime error to the compile time.
Will you implement it? It's fine if you decide to file an issue instead to postpone it.

I took a look at babel and found that the error was thrown by the parser. It also has a parser option `allowSuperOutsideMethod`.
This is a little out of control for me, so I will file an issue for it.

issue_context.title: SWC incorrectly Converted Super Class
comments: This closed issue has been automatically locked because it had no new activity for a month. If you are running into a similar issue, please create a new issue with the steps to reproduce. Thank you.

review_comments:
I think `self.extra_var` is empty before `visit_mut_children_with(self)`.
since `self .extra_vars.drain(..)`
I think it is better to have no-op `visit_mut_object_lit`.
It may not have any effect because we handle children before the parent, but if it's the case performance will be improved.

it's used in the test case nested_object_super_property_in_key,
While can't have a no-op, it can be optimized to only visit method keys
